title: Druxt module registry entry
description: One module, as committed to modules/<name>.yml. The validator reads this file rather than carrying its own copy of the rules, so the documented shape and the enforced shape cannot drift apart.

name.description: The registry key: the module's short name with no organisation prefix, matching the file name.

repo.description: The source repository, as owner/name on GitHub.

path.description: The package directory inside repo, for a module published from a monorepo. Absent means the repository root.

category.description: Which part of the stack the module belongs to. core is the framework itself, not every package the monorepo publishes.

status.description: How far along the module is. Not a quality judgement: it says what a visitor can install today.

drupal.description: The Drupal projects or core subsystems the module renders. Empty when it pairs with nothing on the Drupal side, never omitted.

name.description: The Drupal machine name, as it appears in the project's info.yml.

label.description: The human-readable project or subsystem name.

url.description: Written by the sync: the drupal.org project page, where the machine name names a contributed project. Absent for a core subsystem.

icon.description: A file name under icons/, never a URL: the registry serves the icon it holds, and the build resolves the absolute iconUrl into the compiled output. Required for a module the project maintains; optional for anyone else's, where the build draws a lettermark instead.

website.description: Where the module presents itself. The sync defaults it to the GitHub repository, so the field is always populated.

description.description: Written by the sync from the module's own package.json. Not hand-edited.

npm.description: Written by the sync: the published package name, or absent when the module has never been published.

maintainers.description: Written by the sync from the module's repository.

compatibility.description: Written by the sync from the module's own peerDependencies.

druxt.description: The module's declared Druxt range, from its peerDependencies or, failing that, its dependencies. unknown when it declares neither.

type.description: Written by the sync from the owner of repo. A committed value that disagrees with the derived one is an error, not an override.

aliases.description: Search synonyms, so a visitor who types the npm name or the Drupal machine name finds the entry. Maintained by the project, not by a listing.

archived.description: Written by the sync from GitHub. A listed module whose repository is archived says so rather than looking maintained.

x-druxt-owners.description: Maps a repository owner to the type derived from it. An owner absent here derives 3rd-party.

x-druxt-legacy-owners.description: Owners the project is leaving. A listing from one of these warns and passes: the reviewer decides whether to list it now or wait for its migration.

x-druxt-build-fields.description: Resolved by the build into the compiled output and never committed to a registry file.
